resources.string: Lets Celeste on your computer see this screen and tap, only when you allow it on the phone.

Phone control for Celeste. When the assistant on your computer needs the screen for a task, this phone asks you first, for up to 15 minutes. While it works you see a coloured border and a Stop button, and pressing volume down three times also stops it. It never types into password fields, never touches password managers or Android\'s installer, does nothing while the phone is locked, and, if you switch on “Ask again before buttons like Send, Pay or Delete”, asks again before those. What it sees goes to your AI vendor while it works. The rest of the time it does nothing.
